subject: Money
title: Yield Curve Control
description: A quick win: understand Yield Curve Control.

hook.text: Japan's central bank said ten-year bond yields must stay near 0%. For years, it bought every bond necessary.

buildup.text: Yield curve control means setting a target for long-term rates and buying unlimited bonds to maintain it.

discovery.text: Unlike QE, which targets a quantity of purchases, YCC targets a rate. The commitment is open-ended.

twist.text: In 2023, Japan widened its target band. Markets surged—even a small tweak from YCC moves billions.

climax.text: YCC gives central banks enormous control but requires credibility. If markets doubt the target, costs explode.

punchline.text: Set the rate. Buy whatever it takes.

quiz.question: How does yield curve control differ from quantitative easing?
options: YCC targets a specific interest rate, not a purchase quantity
YCC only applies to short-term bonds
